title: Extension by zero of an integer multiplicity current carried by a compact set
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and B ⊆ U ⊆ ℝ^P with B open, let K ⊆ B be compact, and let X ∈ 𝒟_n(B) be represented by an IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in B. Assume that the weight μ_X = R.measure = θHⁿ⌞M vanishes near every point of B ∖ K: for each y ∈ B with y ∉ K there is ρ > 0 with μ_X(B_ρ(y)) = 0. Then there is E ∈ 𝒟_n(U) such that E is integer multiplicity in U, E(ι ω) = X(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(B) (ι = testFormOnInclusion), and E(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) whose topological support is disjoint from K.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U B K : Set (Euclid P)) (hBU : B ⊆ U) (X : GeometricCurrentOn B n) (R : IMRep B n), IsOpen B → IsCompact K → K ⊆ B → R.Represents X → (∀ y ∈ B, y ∉ K → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ R.measure (ball y ρ) = 0) → ∃ E : GeometricCurrentOn U n, IsIntegerMultiplicity E ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn B n, E (testFormOnInclusion hBU n ω) = X ω) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) K → E ω = 0
